sentences.text: Since 1972, Canada's income tax system has allowed families with child care expenses related to work to deduct these expenses from taxable income before income tax rates are applied.
In the 1970s, as more mothers became employed outside the home, the demand for child care increased.
By the 1990s, the federal approach to cost-sharing had changed, with the Government of Canada replacing open-ended cost-sharing programs with block transfers.

In the 1970s, as more mothers became employed outside the home, the demand for child care increased. By the 1990s, the federal approach to cost-sharing had changed, with the Government of Canada replacing open-ended cost-sharing programs with block transfers.
